headline_stat.name: POST vs PRE significant-replay rate (Achilles), chi2=32.6

stated_limitation: The honest caveat is that the sleep effect is a difference between small percentages, and it is not uniform: POST exceeds PRE in three of the five linear-maze sessions, is slightly lower in one (Cicero_09172014, 1.3% against 1.8%), and drops to zero in Buddy, which contributed only 20 POST candidate events against 175 in PRE. The PRE rate of 1.6% sitting below the nominal 5% is the sign that the three-shuffle conjunction is conservative rather than permissive

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 (Grosmark & Buzsaki CA1) is the canonical known-good dataset for sharp-wave ripples and replay in exactly the right species, region, and PRE/maze/POST paradigm.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile, correct 1250 Hz LFP, non-REM-restricted z-scoring, principled ripple-channel selection by spectral bump, and units tagged by cell type and state.
justification.analysis: Standard SWR detection plus memoryless Bayesian decoding scored by weighted correlation, gated on three independent shuffles (column-cycle, field-identity, time-bin) with PRE sleep as a built-in negative control.
justification.correctness: Every headline number reproduces exactly from the committed CSVs, values are internally consistent across figures and text, and the statistics (chi-square, three-shuffle conjunction) are sound and physically plausible.
justification.figures: Figures are clean, fully labeled with units and sample sizes, and show the ripple, laminar sink, place fields, and decoded replay sweeps convincingly, including an honest null-behavior panel.
justification.honesty: The write-up names the specific weaknesses (small percentages, effect absent or reversed in two of five sessions, conservative test, liberal column-cycle shuffle) rather than presenting the sleep effect as clean.
